_provenance.notes: Tanner Crab (Chionoecetes bairdi) is a major commercial crab species in the Bering Sea, Gulf of Alaska, and Prince William Sound. Larger than Snow Crab (opilio), Tanner crab fisheries have experienced cyclical booms and collapses. The fishery is managed under minimum male carapace width limits (5.5 inches in GOA, 4.8 inches in EBS).
